truth: Real Q4_0 GGUF inference ran on CPU in a GitHub-hosted runner. Real go-libp2p Noise transport ran and a real model-produced decision artifact was carried over a Noise-secured libp2p stream with SHA-256 verification. The cross-peer proof still used two libp2p hosts inside one CI runner; direct two-physical-host libp2p remains unproven.
quality_gate: The 0.8B brain is advisory. Its prose may contain technical mistakes (for example confusing a SHA-256 digest with a digital signature), so it cannot directly authorize execution. Deterministic capability, signature, allowlist, test and attestation gates remain authoritative.
